title: CoT Length vs. Faithfulness: Does More Thinking Mean More Honest Thinking?

original_idea.body: Manipulate CoT length via budget-forcing; measure verbalization vs realized length.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: tests whether the 'think more' prompt-level intervention actually improves faithfulness.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Accessible: budget-forcing prompts, measure verbalization vs length; beginner-friendly.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped: vary CoT length, plot verbalization vs realized length.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly, public models, weak lab incentive.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference with varied budgets on one open model; single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Causal CoT-length-vs-verbalization may be an open angle.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Causal effect of CoT length on verbalization plausibly open.
